source: recorded during a probe of the live account, in a private repository that is not published here -- a test pinning what a token renewal with an already-dead token actually returns. NOT re-observable here: renewing rotates a token a live session is authenticated with. The HTTP status is not recorded there; 401 is this file's own assumption and nothing keys on it.
why_it_matters: An expired token produces an ordinary error body. A client that read it as a venue rejection would report every order dead once its token aged out, mid-session, on the 24-hour boundary.
